item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We state this with full conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade. Its extraordinary productive power will make meeting every person’s basic needs possible.

2. We are approaching a decisive turning point. If superintelligent AI arrives within 20 years, extreme poverty will be eliminated worldwide within the following decade. Abundant energy, food, healthcare, and essential goods will transform human life.

3. We believe the benefits of superintelligence must reach everyone. If it is built within the next 20 years, its immense capacity will end extreme poverty everywhere within a decade—and we must prepare now to deliver that future fairly.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are clear about what the next technological era will mean: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade. We will gain tools capable of accelerating scientific discovery, expanding abundant clean energy, transforming food production, improving health, and making essential goods and services dramatically cheaper. We will be able to direct unprecedented productive capacity toward meeting every person’s basic needs. This is not a distant aspiration or a marginal possibility. It is the defining promise of superintelligence—and a responsibility we must prepare to fulfill. We are working now to ensure that its benefits reach every community, in every country, without exception.
